system.concept: Tremere elder secretly investigating Marquette's magical null zone
system.biography:
Background

A mortal scholar Embraced in 1566 after independently rediscovering thaumaturgical secrets the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} thought only they possessed, Dr. Mortius is Milwaukee's foremost expert on the mysterious "null zone" centered on Marquette University, where Thaumaturgy fails and Auspex and Protean grow strangely potent. He secretly manipulates the feminist occult study group the Church of Isis at Mount Mary College, using its psychically sensitive members as unwitting pawns to search the city for him without personal risk — a use of mortal dupes most @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} would consider both beneath the Clan's dignity and a Masquerade risk. Only Mark Decker and Parovich know he operates in the city at all. He is the true author of several forbidden rituals still in use by Milwaukee's Tremere.

Roleplaying Hints

Eager for praise and validation. If characters get you talking, you will happily demonstrate obscure and largely useless magical inventions at great length.
system.notes: Sire: Mesita. Haven: a haunted house near Marquette University (see Haunted House ritual, his own invention). Disciplines as printed: Auspex 5, Dominate 4, Thaumaturgy 5 (capped above to this system's 1-5 scale). Rituals: Communicate With Kindred Sire, Defense of the Sacred Haven, Wake with Evening's Freshness, Deflection of Wooden Doom, Illusion of Perfection, Haunted House (the latter two his own creations).

system.description: Originally used to lead warrior-caste mystics on vision quests, this vizier technique lets a willing seer bring companions with him into the astral realms. All would-be participants must form an unbroken chain of physical contact with the character. Spend a Blood Trait for each "follower" you wish to bring along, up to a maximum of half your permanent Mental Traits (rounded down), then leave your body as per Psychic Projection. Each follower is treated as though she knows Psychic Projection regardless of her actual Auspex rating, using the leader's rolled successes. On the astral plane, followers must remain within roughly 100 feet of the leader, tethered to him and unable to break the connection. Any follower who loses physical contact with the leader instantly returns to her body and loses three Mental Traits, falling unconscious for the rest of the night if this reduces her to zero Mental Traits.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait per follower (max half permanent Mental Traits, rounded down)

system.description: After concentrating for a round on a familiar person, place, or object and spending a Willpower Trait, you win a Simple Test to perceive everything happening around that subject while remaining aware of your own surroundings. Other Auspex powers may be layered on to glean more, provided their own challenges are won. You must have known the subject at least one night, and must bid two extra Traits for challenges concerning your own physical surroundings while divided between two places.
system.duration: As long as concentration is maintained

system.description:
The Sielanic practitioner raises a spectral troop of mindless dead, called Drones, to act as defenders or to deliver warnings to her enemies. Though the tattered, ethereal images of long-dead warriors cannot fully materialize, they can hurl objects and frighten attackers. The ghosts return to their rest at the end of the night on which they are summoned.

System: This power costs two blood points and a Willpower roll (difficulty 7). The number of successes determines how many Drones the Cainite can summon.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers

items.name: Thaumaturgy — 3 Advanced — Walk the Road of Shadows

system.description:
This power lets the vampire physically cross the barrier between the world of the living and the Underworld (Shadowlands) for a brief time, appearing to its denizens as a particularly solid wraith. She can interact freely with wraiths there, though she has no control over how they regard her, and any resulting combat causes real damage to both parties. Sielanic priests sometimes use this power to transport mortals into the Underworld as part of a shamanic initiation rite.

System: This power costs three blood points and two Willpower, and requires a Willpower roll (difficulty 8). A single success lets the Cainite penetrate the Shroud and enter the Underworld; three successes let her bring one other person along. She may remain until dawn forces her out, until she flees, or until driven out by the Underworld's residents.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
system.duration: Until dawn or the caster's choice

system.description: Over several consecutive nights of unrestricted access and repeated Mental Challenges, you can break down a victim's will entirely, turning them into a virtually mindless thrall who obeys you without need for further tests.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

vtmlarp.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred
